interest: Tracks Japanese government-subsidized emigration of 50,000 settlers to Brazil.
overview: Docket for file 894.5632 indexes a 1932 memo on Japan subsidizing passage for 50,000 Brazil emigrants, cross-referenced elsewhere.

subfiles.about: A State Department List of Papers sheet cataloguing a 1932 memorandum regarding Japanese government subsidies for emigrants traveling to Brazil.
subfiles.summary: Indexes Whittington's 1932 memo on Japan subsidizing passage for about 50,000 emigrants to Brazil, cross-referenced to file 894.56/67.
